slot.brief: Zener diode regulator circuit with source, series resistance and load; find current through Zener and load, and power dissipated when input voltage varies (high difficulty numerical).

stem: An ideal $12$ V Zener regulator has a $180\ \Omega$ series resistor. The input varies from $18$ V to $24$ V, and the load varies from $720\ \Omega$ to $1440\ \Omega$. The Zener operates from $5\ \text{mA}$ to $60\ \text{mA}$ and is rated at $0.75\ \text{W}$. Which choice gives $(I_Z,I_L,P_Z)$ at maximum Zener dissipation and correctly states whether the regulator stays within its limits over the full range?
options: $58.3\ \text{mA},\ 8.33\ \text{mA},\ 0.70\ \text{W}$; within limits over the full range

verdicts.working: At 24 V and 1440 Ω, the series current is (24−12)/180 = 66.7 mA and the load current is 12/1440 = 8.33 mA, so IZ = 58.3 mA and PZ = 0.70 W. Across the full range, IZ is smallest at 18 V and 720 Ω: 33.3−16.7 = 16.7 mA. Thus IZ stays within 5–60 mA, and the maximum Zener power is below 0.75 W.

working:
$I_{L,\max}=12/720=16.7\ \text{mA}$; $I_{Z,\min}=(18-12)/180-16.7=16.7\ \text{mA}>5\ \text{mA}$. At maximum dissipation, $V_{in}=24\ \text{V}$ and $R_L=1440\ \Omega$: $I_L=8.33\ \text{mA}$, $I_Z=66.67-8.33=58.3\ \text{mA}$. $P_Z=12(0.0583)=0.70\ \text{W}<0.75\ \text{W}$; $I_Z<60\ \text{mA}$.

Independent check: At 24 V and 1440 Ω, the series current is (24−12)/180 = 66.7 mA and the load current is 12/1440 = 8.33 mA, so IZ = 58.3 mA and PZ = 0.70 W. Across the full range, IZ is smallest at 18 V and 720 Ω: 33.3−16.7 = 16.7 mA. Thus IZ stays within 5–60 mA, and the maximum Zener power is below 0.75 W.
solution:
The maximum Zener current occurs at maximum input voltage and maximum load resistance:
$$I_Z=\frac{24-12}{180}-\frac{12}{1440}=58.3\ \text{mA},\qquad I_L=8.33\ \text{mA}.$$
Thus $P_Z=12(0.0583)=0.70\ \text{W}$. At the opposite extreme, $I_{Z,\min}=\frac{18-12}{180}-\frac{12}{720}=16.7\ \text{mA}$, so current and power remain within their limits over the full range.
